children: Gold prices dropped on Monday, September 21, as the 24-karat price fell to EGP 7,279 for purchase and EGP 7,198 for sale, according to Dahab Masr data at 2:38 PM.
The 21-karat gold amounted to EGP 6,370.26 for buying and EGP 6,299.47 for selling.
Meanwhile, the 18-karat was priced at EGP 5,464.68 for buying and EGP 5,399.55 for selling.
A gold coin recorded EGP 51,003 for purchase and EGP 50,395.76 for sale.
On the global level, the international ounce hit $4,360.9 for buying and $4,360.3 for selling.

title: ZAWYA: Gold prices in Egypt slightly down on September 21
